what_happened.line: The commission voted to write and send a letter on farm complaints to the chairs and administrators of the select board, board of health and building department.
The letter is to carry a cc list and a new date, with the addressees set as the chairpersons and administrators of the three offices.
The commission reorganized by roll call, electing a chair, then a vice chair, then a clerk, with no opposition heard.
Members will each list flyer ideas for the next meeting and ask Westminster and Rutland contacts about their Facebook pages.
The next meeting was set for October 15th by Zoom.

why_it_matters: A farmer or neighbor with a complaint about a farm may soon find it routed through the select board, board of health and building department, so the letter shapes which office handles it.
Farm-size bylaw changes and a public market article were discussed, and warrant articles like these are put to voters at Town Meeting.
watch_next: The October 15th Zoom meeting, where members bring flyer ideas and Facebook page findings.
Whether the farm-size bylaw and public market articles reach the Town Meeting warrant.
